entries.50404b223456650f: Viewed by median rather than total, [[industry:automotive|Automotive]] (3,777.5 employees) ranks first here as well, showing that it is an industry where large companies are concentrated. In contrast, [[industry:it|IT and Software]] has the largest number of companies of any industry, yet its median is small, and it is an industry with many small companies. The smallest is [[industry:real-estate|Real Estate]] (225.5 employees), where businesses that operate by holding and turning over assets can be sustained with a small number of people.

entries.7d620b35582edaf2: The number of employees is as printed in the "Trends in Key Management Indicators and Other Data" section of each company's annual securities report, and the total is a simple sum of those figures (the only calculated values are the totals and percentages). Companies that do not print the number of employees for the most recent fiscal period are not included.
entries.9455c30296f5f9d5: Of the 3,132 companies listed, 3,118 printed the number of employees for the latest fiscal period, and totaling those numbers gives 13,885,112 people. The number of employees here is the number printed in the "Trends in Key Management Indicators" section of the annual securities report, and for companies that prepare consolidated financial statements, it is the number for the group as a whole. Because the counting method differs from the "Status of Employees" section on each company's page (the number for the filing company only), only this figure is used here, without mixing the two. The median company size was 757.5 people.
entries.96a933c43975018b: This is a map that totals the number of employees for the latest fiscal period by industry and arranges them alongside the median company size.
entries.98e3ab364e5990cc: The largest is [[industry:automotive|Automotive]], followed by [[industry:electronics|Electrical Equipment and Electronics]] and [[industry:chemicals|Chemicals]]. These 3 industries account for 41.8% of the total. The lineup reflects the breadth of the manufacturing base, including parts manufacturers. Meanwhile, [[industry:telecommunications|Telecommunications]] ranks high with 558,599 people despite having only 26 companies. Of these, [[company:ntt|NTT]] alone, as 1 company, has 344,196 people, 61.6% of the industry. In industries with few companies, the size of 1 company directly becomes the picture of the industry.
